name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A native modal dialog with header, title, description, footer and close parts, three sizes, right and bottom sheets and a morph from its trigger. CSS-only motion.

.rx-dialog.transition: opacity var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), scale var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), translate var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), display var(--_exit) allow-discrete, overlay var(--_exit) allow-discrete

.rx-dialog[open].transition: opacity 200ms var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-panel-duration) var(--spring-panel), translate var(--spring-panel-duration) var(--spring-panel), display var(--spring-panel-duration) allow-discrete, overlay var(--spring-panel-duration) allow-discrete

.rx-dialog::backdrop.transition: background-color var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), backdrop-filter var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), display var(--_exit) allow-discrete, overlay var(--_exit) allow-discrete

.rx-dialog-close.transition: background-color 150ms var(--motion-ease), color 150ms var(--motion-ease), opacity 200ms var(--motion-ease) 120ms, scale var(--spring-press-duration) var(--spring-press) 120ms
